welcome_text: Welcome to Our School Welcome to Young School of Ellicott City! Our school is conveniently located on Bethany Lane here in Ellicott City. We're pleased to offer programming for infants through pre-kindergarten with flexible full- and part-time schedule options to meet your family's needs. Classes are taught by our dedicated teaching staff who participate in ongoing professional development and training, including maintaining current Infant/Child First Aid and CPR certifications. We're committed to keeping you connected throughout the day while your child is in our care. Get access to live streaming video of your child's classroom, plus other real-time updates, with our exclusive mobile app for families, SproutAbout. I encourage you to schedule a tour today to experience our state-of-the-art facility, which features a dedicated infant/toddler play area, a wrap around deck including outdoor classroom areas, and more! I look forward to meeting you and your family soon!
